title: Prove behaviour, not just a build
text: Prove a port's behaviour, not just its build. The first try (overlay inspected, AppleSkin inventory change 95.6%, save reloads at the same position) was re-marked to "loads" on 2026-10-26: a frame change and a save reload happen without the mod. Behaviour needs an assertion on the mod's own state (`--assert` on its class, `--expect-value` on its screen).
result: `tools/tests/AppleSkinHudCheck.java` checks AppleSkin's HUD estimate against real regeneration on the 1.21.6 port, and fails when the estimate is broken on purpose.
